ex.en: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
What are the odds of finishing on time?
ex.zh: 準時完成的機率有多大？

odds.zh: at odds：意見不合、互相矛盾

ex.en: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
ex.zh: 那兩個部門有時候意見不合。

ex.en: His actions are at odds with his words.

odds.zh: against (all) the odds：儘管困難重重

ex.en: Against all odds, the startup succeeded.
ex.zh: 儘管困難重重，那家新創公司還是成功了。

ex.en: She won the race against the odds.
Don't you think it odd that she was in such a hurry?
ex.zh: 她那麼匆忙，你不覺得很奇怪嗎？

ex.en: I know people think I'm odd.
ex.zh: 我知道大家覺得我很怪。

ex.en: He is the odd one of the family.
One, three, and five are odd numbers.
Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
ex.zh: 偶數乘以奇數是偶數，奇數乘以奇數是奇數。

odd.zh: 零星的、臨時的；不成對的

ex.en: He did odd jobs around the neighborhood during the summer.
I found an odd sock under the bed.
ex.zh: 我在床底下找到一隻不成對的襪子。

ex.en: Those two departments are sometimes at odds with each other.
ex.zh: 那兩個部門有時候意見不合。

ex.en: His actions are at odds with what he says.
ex.zh: 他的行為和他說的不一致。
